tasks.title: Reduce unnecessary editor redraws during playback
tasks.instructions: Inspect playback-related render paths in src/app.js. Identify ONE redundant DOM rewrite or event-handler rebinding during playback and avoid it safely. Preserve all preview, caption and timeline behavior. Add a focused regression test if feasible. Do not attempt a broad render refactor.

tasks.title: Keep timeline controls stable when the Windows window resizes
tasks.instructions: Inspect editor timeline layout and resize handling. Fix ONE reproducible cause of controls jumping, overflowing or becoming unusable on window shrink. Prefer a targeted CSS or resize-handler correction, with a regression check where feasible.

tasks.title: Ensure captions-off remains off in preview and exported video
tasks.instructions: Trace the captions-off flag from editor UI to preview and FFmpeg export. Fix ONE concrete mismatch only if found; otherwise add a focused regression test proving captions-off stays off. Avoid changing FFmpeg encoding defaults.

tasks.title: Protect the keep-entire-video mode for short videos
tasks.instructions: Inspect short-video trimming and full-video override. Fix ONE issue where a short input is unexpectedly shortened or the preview desynchronizes after keep-entire-video is chosen. Add a targeted test; preserve manual trim.

tasks.title: Preserve editable hook position through preview and export
tasks.instructions: Inspect hook/title position state, drag interaction, preview and export. Address ONE concrete mismatch or add regression coverage. Do not redesign the hook editor.

tasks.title: Prevent grey background regressions with Twitch subtitle cropout
tasks.instructions: Inspect Twitch subtitle cropout and blurred background composition. Fix ONE clear grey-background regression or add a focused regression test. Keep crop and FFmpeg behavior compatible.

tasks.title: Prevent duplicate editor listeners after repeated renders
tasks.instructions: Inspect a frequently re-rendered editor control for duplicate event listeners or cleanup omissions. Fix ONE concrete case and add targeted coverage if feasible. Avoid global event architecture changes.

tasks.title: Stop unnecessary preview polling when playback is inactive
tasks.instructions: Inspect requestAnimationFrame, video frame callbacks, timers or polling. Fix ONE unnecessary loop when preview is paused, detached or editor closed. Preserve responsiveness on resume.

tasks.title: Improve one preview/export consistency edge case
tasks.instructions: Compare preview and FFmpeg export handling for crop, subtitles or scaling. Identify and fix ONE well-defined discrepancy, with regression coverage. Avoid broad export pipeline changes.

tasks.title: Keep export progress UI responsive
tasks.instructions: Inspect progress reporting and UI updates during FFmpeg export. Fix ONE redundant synchronous UI operation or overly frequent update that harms responsiveness. Do not change encoding, cancellation or output format.
